what: Three lanes (AI, R8, DF2) edit head_record.rs in one directory. The runner cuts whole files from disk, so my ask carried DF2's half-finished `field_defaults` edit and failed on five of DF2's errors. None of the errors were on my lines.
cost: one admission round, and my piece and R8's both wait on DF2
cause: a cut takes a whole file; one file shared by three lanes cannot be admitted for one of them while another is mid-edit
workaround: told main; wait for DF2's file to compile, then ask again unchanged
fix: split head_record.rs per head kind (fn, adt, trait, ...) so that lanes touching different kinds hold different files, or let the queue cut hunks per lane
